title: Spa Filter Maintenance Failure Rate
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spa:filter
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(filter_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by filter_id
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often spa filter maintenance records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each filter.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize filter_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per filter.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals which parts of your spa filter maintenance data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
